text: Independent fluid/MHD comparisons and CT/GLM Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-mhd-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++ Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Unit square, gamma=5/3, mu0=1, vz=Bz=0, t=0.05. rho=25/(36pi), p=5/(12pi), v=(-sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(-sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi). Editorial clarification The adopted GLM uses ch=3 and damping rate kappa=0.18 ch n, with n cells per axis: damping is grid dependent. Both use the same continuous initial field, final time and CFL, while actual step counts and native div B operators differ. Adopted numerical method Reuse the published first-order Rusanov/forward-Euler solvers: shared corner-EMF discrete curl for CT and cell-centered hyperbolic/parabolic GLM cleaning. Independent Athena++ uses HLLD, PLM and RK2. ∇⋅B=0,Bt+∇×E=0∇⋅B=0,Bt​+∇×E=0 References and measured quantities Measure density/By L1 error, mass/energy drift and positivity on 16²/32²/64². Check the independent 128²/256² reference and conservatively restrict its fine-cell averages. Verification limits and failures Face CT divergence and centered GLM divergence use different operators; common cell-centered diagnostics are also reported. Athena initializes face-averaged magnetic fields by differencing a vector potential, so comparison includes discretization differences of identical continuous data. This is a short planar test, not validation of shocks, 3D, UCT or CTU. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
